title: Sukkah 5b — Practice Quiz
source: Questions and correct answers taken directly from the Dafyomi Advancement Forum quiz for Sukkah 5 (dafyomi.co.il/sukah/quiz/su-qz-005.htm), questions 4–6.

questions.q: How do we know the sechach must be above 10 tefachim of interior space — maybe the total height (including the sechach) just needs to be 10 tefachim?
options: We learn from the kaporet and aron
It says the cherubs' wings screened the kaporet, and they were 10 tefachim high
questions.explain: For Rabbi Meir's cubit-reckoning, the cherub-wing calculation cleanly proves it. For Rabbi Yehuda's, the math doesn't land on a clean 10, so it has to fall back on orally-transmitted halachah instead. Both routes are live, hence disputed.

questions.q: How were the cherubs' wings positioned?
questions.explain: The verse says "upward" (not repeated, so not "way above") — the wings were spread above the cherubs' heads, which is what lets their span count as "sechach" sitting 10 tefachim up.

questions.q: How many tefachim were in the amah shel keilim (the cubit used for measuring vessels)?
questions.explain: Rabbi Yehuda holds the vessel-cubit was 5 tefachim (vs. 6 for a building-cubit); Rabbi Meir holds all cubits were a uniform 6. So the value itself depends on whose position you follow — disputed between 5 and 6.
